newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgium recalls ambassador to Iran.
newsitem.headline: Belgium recalls ambassador to Iran.

text.p: Belgium, following the lead of the European Union's political directors, has recalled its ambassador to Iran for consultations, a foreign ministry spokesman said on Friday.
"The decision was taken yesterday and the instructions will be issued today," he said. "He is rushing back and we expect him to be here by Monday."
But the spokesman insisted that Belgium was not closing its embassy in Tehran.
"The ambassador is just coming back for consultations," he said.

The recommendation of the EU's political directors followed a ruling on Thursday by a court in Germany accusing Iran's leaders of having sanctioned the murders of a group of Iranian Kurdish leaders in a Berlin restaurant in 1992.
